contract: Strong and live-map/live-key ephemeron least fixed point; safety, completeness and abstract termination.
The exact generic production driver terminates and clears waiting state, conditional on the three EphemeronTrace adapter contracts.
Exact mark_word/dead_word bit operations for all u64 inputs; preservation and disjointness.

Exact new/is_live/check/get/get_mut/mark/is_marked/clear_marks bodies: bounded access, fresh marks, other bits unchanged, zeroed bitmap, payload and metadata framing, in normal and gc-stress configurations. Requires live indices and consistent bitmap lengths; allocation and sweep preservation of these premises remains separate.

Exact boxed/kind/is_heap/payload_if and four heap constructors/decoders for all bit patterns; correct arena namespace and u32 payload, including constructor/decoder composition. Does not prove that a decoded index is allocated or belongs to this heap.
Exact push_heap_values terminates and appends precisely the heap-valued subsequence, preserving the previous queue and input order/multiplicity.

All nine RootStack methods and Handles create/get/set/release/live_count preserve their exact sequence/free-list invariants. Caller must supply valid marks/indices, nonempty handle values, active handles, and representable slot counts. Does not prove Handles::values iterator, derived Default implementation, or callers' lifetime/heap ownership discipline.
Exact skip/enqueue/wait decision; the caller must establish map liveness.
Interval split/coalesce and set-level allocation/release/quarantine preserve a disjoint partition; actual allocator tested separately.
Independent typed graph covers all current arenas and compares production marks and survivors during tests/gc-stress. Not a universal refinement proof.
WeakPass scan/drain/clear must implement driver.rs.in. Provenance, work progress and activation checks run in tests/gc-stress; full contract refinement remains unproved.
Production callbacks, free counts, cursor, quarantine, shrinking, payload preservation and value-heap partition are tested; full allocator refinement remains unproved.
New jobs and pruned caches reference retained nodes before sweep; the abstract root-addition and pruning lemmas are in model.rs.
Every mutator must root values needed after a safepoint. Root enumeration is independently checked; neither that nor the model proves all callers follow the rule.

The abstract graph is immutable during marking. Individual arena marking operations now have record/metadata frame proofs, but content preservation across the complete tracer, weak processing and sweep is not mechanically proved; survivor payloads are also checked in behavioral tests.
Finite well-formed heap, representable indices, sufficient host memory for collector work buffers, no concurrent mutator or callback during marking. This is not an OOM/heap-cap proof.
